title: TransferCertificateExtractionSchema
description: Schema for extracting structured data from a Nepali School Transfer Certificate including all visible header, student, academic, and authentication fields.

school_name.description: School name in uppercase as present at top heading (e.g. 'LEARNING REALM INTERNATIONAL (L.R.I.) SCHOOL').

school_address.description: Full school address block below the name, including city, country and postal details as printed.

school_contact.description: Full contact block for the school: phone, GPO, email, and URL (as one block, all lines, as printed).

school_logo_label.description: Label for the top school logo (above the school name header). Always set as 'School Logo'.

certificate_title.description: The bold, underlined heading in the middle (e.g. 'CHARACTER-CUM-TRANSFER CERTIFICATE').

student_full_name.description: Full name of the student as printed in the certificate text (e.g. 'Master Aaditya Joshi').

father_name.description: Full name and title of the student's father as printed (e.g. 'Dr. Devkant Joshi').

grade.description: Student's grade-level with both numeral and words as printed (e.g. 'Grade-10 (Ten)').

academic_session.description: Academic session string (both BS and AD if present), e.g. '2022/23 (2079)'.

exam_name.description: Board exam name as printed (e.g. 'Secondary Education Examination (S.E.E.)').

exam_year.description: Year in which exam was passed, as printed after 'year', e.g. '2023'.

symbol_no.description: Symbol number for board exam (e.g., '02905947 E').

dob_bs.description: Date of birth in BS calendar, as per records (e.g. '2064/02/17 BS').

dob_ad.description: Date of birth in AD calendar (e.g. '31/05/2007 AD').

character_statement.description: Sentence describing moral character, e.g. 'To the best of our knowledge and belief, he bears a good moral character.'

co_curricular_statement.description: Sentence describing extra-curricular involvement and achievements, as printed.

principal_name.description: Name of principal as signed and printed (e.g. 'Dr. Devkant Joshi').

principal_title.description: Principal's title/role as printed below signature (e.g. 'PRINCIPAL').

principal_signature_label.description: Signature placeholder label below principal's signature (always '(Signed)').

school_seal_label.description: Label for circular school seal/stamp (always 'School Seal').
